calls.title: Sam Bartek and Graham McNicoll
calls.summary: During the Vendor Discussion meeting, Sam Bartek and Maria from Scale AI met with Graham McNicoll from Growth Book to explore the integration of Growth Book's open-source experimentation platform into Scale AI. They reviewed the enterprise tier features such as self-hosting, SSO, role-based access, and pricing structures, which can be seat-based or site licenses. The technical implementation details included using MongoDB and Snowflake for data storage, with a straightforward infrastructure setup. Support options highlighted included quick bug fixes and a shared Slack channel for enterprise customers. Action items included Graham sending detailed documentation and a trial license, while Sam would follow up on security requirements and gauge team interest in the enterprise tier.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Growth Book, Enterprise tier, Self-hosting, MongoDB, Snowflake
